AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


About the Opportunity

In this role, you will join MoonPay’s Crypto Asset Management team as a Product Manager, helping us build and scale the liquidity and asset infrastructure that supports products across MoonPay.

The team is responsible for how liquidity is sourced and distributed across our platform, supporting high-value crypto transaction volumes across multiple assets, venues, and blockchains. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it.

You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.

Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

What You Will Do

  • Own day-to-day product execution across Crypto Asset Management initiatives, translating business, technical, operational, and compliance requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, and delivery milestones.

  • Support integrations with new liquidity sources, including centralised exchanges, OTC trading desks, and decentralised services, helping expand MoonPay’s liquidity network and improve sourcing efficiency, reliability, and execution.

  • Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery.

  • Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions.

  • Support roadmap development and prioritisation, using data, commercial value, operational requirements, customer impact, risk, and engineering constraints to help determine which initiatives should be addressed first.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our liquidity and asset-management infrastructure, including custody and wallet capabilities, liquidity routing, best execution, settlement efficiency, monitoring, and risk-management tooling.

  • Use data to evaluate product performance and opportunities, identifying friction, operational inefficiencies, or areas where product and infrastructure improvements can create measurable value for MoonPay and its customers.

 

 

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • You have experience working in product management, product operations, treasury, finance, business analysis, technical programme delivery, or a similar role, and can take a problem from initial requirements through to structured execution.

  • You are comfortable working across cross-functional teams, particularly with Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, or Commercial stakeholders, and can turn complex or ambiguous requirements into clear actions and priorities.

  • You have strong product thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to understand trade-offs, use data to support decisions, and prioritise work based on business and customer impact.

  • You have a genuine interest in crypto, fintech, or financial infrastructure and are motivated to build a deeper understanding of areas such as blockchain networks, liquidity, exchanges, custody, wallets, and digital-asset infrastructure.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Previous exposure to crypto or fintech infrastructure, particularly liquidity management, exchange or OTC integrations, stablecoins, custody, wallets, or DeFi protocols.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with regulated financial products, crypto compliance requirements, blockchain infrastructure, or products handling high-value financial transactions.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

data.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a Working Student to join our Growth team and support everything TYTAN communicates outward — across social media, press, and marketing. You will sit at the point where our technology becomes a public message, and you will help shape how TYTAN is seen by media, by the public, and by decision-makers in politics and defence. 

Everything we publish is read by journalists, ministries, investors, and competitors. We are looking for someone with the editorial instinct — and the discretion — to work at that level.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

  • Social Media: Run the day-to-day of TYTAN’s LinkedIn channel. Draft and schedule posts, maintain the editorial calendar, manage the comment section, and keep our voice consistent across every publication. 

  • Content Production: Turn material from flight tests, the production floor, and events into publishable content — short-form video, photography, and graphics — in line with our corporate identity and our filming and photography policy. 

  • Media Monitoring: Track coverage of TYTAN, of our competitors, and of the wider Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) and defence-policy debate. Prepare clippings and resonance analyses the team can act on. 

  • Press Support: Support press work end to end: maintain journalist contact lists, help prepare briefings and one-pagers, and assist in coordinating interviews and incoming inquiries. 

  • Events: Support our presence at trade fairs, conferences, and stakeholder formats in Munich, Berlin, and Brussels — from content preparation in advance to live coverage on the day. 

  • Marketing Assets: Help produce and maintain outward-facing collateral, including website copy, newsletters, the media kit, and campaign materials. 

  • Performance: Report on channel performance, identify what works, and bring your own proposals for what we should do differently. 


  • Currently enrolled as a student (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Communications, Media, Marketing, Journalism, Political Science, International Relations, or a related field 

  • Demonstrable hands-on social media skill — you have run channels yourself and can show us the work, not only describe it 

  • Excellent writing: you produce clean, publishable copy that needs editing, not rewriting 

  • Business-fluent German and English, both written and spoken 

  • Editorial judgement and discretion: you understand that in defence and politics a single careless post becomes a problem for the entire company, and you know what not to publish 

  • Genuine interest in security and defence policy and in the political debate around European sovereignty 

  • Confident with content and design tools (e.g. Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, LinkedIn analytics, scheduling and video editing tools) 

  • Availability of approximately 20 hours per week during the semester, on-site in Munich, for a minimum of six months 

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

Our Culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-Centric: We care deeply about our team’s growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.

  • Globally Connected: We foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

If you’re passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board!

Role Summary

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a key role in keeping all production systems running smoothly. You will work closely with other engineers and operators to fuse engineering principles, operational knowledge, security, and automation to work towards platform/service production excellence from an angle of infrastructure, reliability, and security. 

The SRE team owns the foundation of AI Platform’s Core platform - the services and infrastructure that let us deploy to a multitude of public cloud providers and that powers many ML and LLM powered features. We give every other engineering team a reliable base to build on, and we own the software delivery lifecycle end to end: the tooling, patterns, and automation that reduce friction for the whole org.

This is an exciting opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to a mission-driven organization.


Responsibilities:

What you’ll own

  • Reliability of platform(includes ML and LLM workloads) - model serving and inference infrastructure (GPU-backed endpoints, autoscaling, latency and cost tradeoffs), with SLOs, on-call, and incident response that cover models, not just services
  • Observability(includes ML models) - drift and performance monitoring for ML, plus LLM-specific tracing, evals, and guardrails, wired into the same metrics and logging stacks we run everywhere else
  • Company-wide technical direction: shaping the roadmap and building golden paths that raise the baseline for every team
  • Developer tooling and automation that compounds - reusable GitHub Actions, GitOps workflows, Terraform modules - so every engineer ships faster
  • Reusable components packaging common open-source tools (Grafana, Istio, CloudNative stack, and ML tooling such as model registries and feature stores) for teams to deploy in any environment
  • Secure-by-default infrastructure - baking security, compliance audits, cost governance, and audit trails into the platform in close partnership with our lead/backend/staff engineers.

Requirements

Who you are (must-haves)

  • 5+ years in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or SRE, operating large-scale, high-availability production systems using Kubernetes
  • Production Operational experience - a live cluster under real load, not a lab. Fluent with Helm, and Terraform or Cloudformation, on at least one major cloud (AWS preferred).
  • Good proficiency in Python or Go or general scripting for automation and tooling(automation with higher language preferred)
  • AI is already in your daily loop - Agentic tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Droid, internal skills) is part of how you ship and not what you are experimenting with. We believe AI tools can be great with human judgement and we want the SRE team to bring the next wave day to day operations. 
  • First-principles reasoning -  Reasoning from constraints and failure modes naming the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off) 
  • At least one infrastructure build you owned end to end - with the outcome metric attached (deploy time, MTTR, cost, adoption, availability).
  • Cross-functional strength. Track record working with product, backend/frontend teams to pull through collective initiative. 

ML & AI platform (strongly preferred)

  • Running ML workloads on Kubernetes - GPU scheduling, capacity, and cost management
  • Model serving and inference at production scale (eg KServe, RayServe, Triton, vLLM, or similar) with real latency and cost constraints(preferred RayServe)
  • MLOps pipeline tooling - training pipelines, model registries, feature stores, and lineage (Kubeflow, MLflow, Feast, Weights & Biases, or equivalents)
  • LLMOps in production - inference serving, prompt/version management, and LLM observability (tracing, evals, drift, guardrails, cost per request)
  • Governing ML/LLM workloads as platform capabilities: data-residency and PII controls, and audit trails

Any other General requirements

  • Global Collaboration: Ability to work across global teams and different cultures across various time zones with strong communication skills.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to break down complex problems into simple, actionable solutions.
  • Ownership & Drive: Tendency to go above and beyond to meet deadlines, manage own deliverables, and assist team members.
  • Availability: Willingness to support processes for 24x7 operational support.

Benefits

At CloudFactory, we believe that work should be more than just a job—it should be a platform for growth, impact, and community. Here, you’ll earn with purpose, learn every day, and serve a mission that truly matters. If you're looking for a career where you can develop professionally, contribute meaningfully, and be part of a global movement, we’d love to have you on this journey!

Join us today and be part of our mission to connect people and technology for a better world! Apply now and bring your whole, authentic self to work—we can’t wait to meet you!

You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.

  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers

Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.
Please apply with your CV and cover letter in PDF format exclusively using the application form at the earliest opportunity. Please indicate in your cover letter your earliest possible start date and your expected daily rate.
Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form.

Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.
  • Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe.
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein. 
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell. 
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.


Was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst. 
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig. 
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll.

Want to make a difference?

As Senior Controller (all genders), you play a key role in the financial steering of ARMEDANGELS. With your strategic perspective on numbers, processes, and business performance, you help ensure that sustainable growth is built on a strong and reliable financial foundation.

You take ownership of further developing budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, create transparency around financial performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business. In doing so, you combine financial excellence with our ambition to operate responsibly and with long-term impact in mind.


Who we are...

Since 2007, ARMEDANGELS has been proving that fashion can be different: innovative and timeless, produced according to responsible standards for people and planet. No wage slavery, no toxic chemicals, no cheap throwaway goods.

What started as a simple idea – printing T-shirts and donating proceeds to social projects – has grown into a company that now ranks among Europe’s leading sustainable lifestyle labels. With a 190-strong team and four collections a year, we show that responsibility and great product design can go hand in hand.


What is the job about?

Strategic Financial Planning & Analysis

You lead and further develop our budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, ensuring they are aligned with our business and growth objectives.

You analyze financial performance, conduct variance analyses, and derive actionable recommendations to support better business decisions.

Internal Controls & Compliance

You will develop and strengthen internal control mechanisms, helping to identify risks early on and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards. 

You will assist with annual financial statement audits in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), participate in audits, and, when necessary, coordinate the implementation of required measures from a controlling perspective.

Financial Reporting & Performance Monitoring

You oversee the preparation of meaningful financial reports, including P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet analysis, creating transparency on the company’s financial performance.

You use KPIs and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and support financial steering.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support

You work closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and other business functions to integrate financial insights into broader business planning.

You prepare decision-ready analyses for senior stakeholders and help ensure strategic choices are grounded in reliable financial data.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

You support and develop colleagues in Finance and Controlling, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

You drive process enhancements and introduce tools, methods, and best practices that improve efficiency and quality in a sustainable way.


We'd love to hear from you if you have

Professional

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5–7+ years of experience in controlling, financial planning, or comparable finance roles
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting
  • Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and financial management software.  Experience with analytics tools such as Looker, PowerBI, or Tableau is a plus
  • Experience with internal controls and compliance-related processes
  • You have knowledge of the German Commercial Code (HGB) and a solid understanding of accounting principles, enabling you to effectively integrate controlling and accounting perspectives.
Personal
  • Strategic and analytical mindset
  • Structured, precise, and solution-oriented way of working
  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence in working with different stakeholders
  • Motivation to support teams and actively improve processes


What can you expect?

Inspiring work environment: Work in an innovative company that operates as sustainably as possible and continuously sets new standards.

Flexibility: Trust-based working hours and the option to work in a hybrid setup.

Team spirit: Enjoy legendary team events, a historic office space, and plenty of dog-friendly energy.

Benefits: €50 monthly benefit via guudcard, ARMEDANGELS shopping vouchers, attractive employee discounts, a JobRad or Germany Ticket, and a company pension scheme.

Support: Our Employee Assistance Program is available to support you confidentially in any life situation.

Come as you are: No dress code – just be yourself.


Good to know before you apply

We appreciate diverse interests, courage, and the drive to make things happen.

Please apply online via the application button and include the following information:

  • Your pronouns and preferred name, if applicable
  • Your CV
  • Your earliest possible start date and salary expectations
  • A few words on why you are excited to join ARMEDANGELS

This helps us get a well-rounded picture of how well we might fit together.

Thank you for your time and interest!

This is a role for someone who wants to own something real, not just execute on someone else's vision.
At Carbmee, we're building the environmental intelligence platform that the world's largest industrial companies use to measure, manage, and reduce their carbon emissions. We work with companies like Maersk, Lufthansa, and Zeiss. And we're growing fast!
As (Senior) Key Account Manager, you'll own and grow our automotive customer base. You'll have real responsibility from day one, and what you build here will actually matter.
You'll spend the majority of your time deepening relationships with existing enterprise accounts (expansion, additional use cases, renewals) while also opening a smaller number of new strategic accounts in the automotive and industrial supplier space.

You'll work directly with our CEO and sales leadership to build the account strategy from the ground up.


Your tasks

  • Own a portfolio of existing automotive enterprise accounts, driving expansion and deepening carbmee's footprint.
  • Identify, develop and close new strategic accounts in automotive and adjacent supplier industries.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across sustainability, procurement, and operations stakeholders at large automotive OEMs and Tier 1/2 suppliers.

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.

  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.

Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

bunch is looking for a (Senior) Finance & Accounting Manager to be the backbone of its day-to-day financial operations.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of accounting, billing, payroll, and process improvement. You will be responsible for key financial operations, including preparatory accounting (vorbereitende Buchhaltung), spend management, and client invoicing across all bunch entities.
We are looking for someone with a strong accounting foundation who has expanded – or would like to further expand – into broader finance topics and take on more responsibility across the finance function.

You will gain direct exposure to the full finance function of a fast-growing fintech, report directly to the Head of Finance, and have the opportunity to grow your role within the Finance Team over time. Candidates with appropriate senior-level experience may join at Senior Manager level.

From day one, you will play a critical role in strengthening and optimising bunch’s financial operations as the company grows and scales across markets.

  • Run quarterly and annual invoicing across all products and jurisdictions and take the lead on reducing manual effort by working with our analytics and other teams to improve and automate our invoicing setup. You'll also track client payments and flag overdue accounts
  • Support our monthly close by coordinating with external accountants across all jurisdictions and entities, ensuring timely delivery of monthly and annual accounts and that our external partners always have what they need on time
  • Support on our regular tax filings, such as for VAT, across our entities
  • Conduct monthly payroll reviews and serve as the internal point of contact for payroll-related questions — including social security, health insurance, pension contributions, and employee benefits — as well as financial employee policies such as expense reimbursement

As an Account Executive you will play a key role in growing Gurobi's presence by identifying new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, and helping organizations solve complex optimization challenges.

You'll own a broad territory and be responsible for developing and executing a strategic territory plan that drives pipeline growth across commercial accounts (SMB). Success in this role requires a proactive, consultative sales approach, strong prospecting skills, and the ability to build lasting relationships with technical and executive stakeholders.

Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Technical Account Management, and Marketing, you'll introduce Gurobi's optimization technology to new markets while helping existing customers expand their use of our solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating demand, navigating complex technical sales cycles, and building long-term partnerships in a relationship-driven market.


What you will be doing?
  • Own and execute the sales strategy across your assigned territory, developing a proactive plan to generate new business and grow existing customer relationships.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, account-based selling, referrals, partner relationships, networking, and marketing-generated opportunities.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value commercial accounts, creating demand in markets where Gurobi has varying levels of brand awareness.
  • Execute a land-and-expand strategy by identifying new buying centers, upsell opportunities, and cross-functional use cases within existing customers.
  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, partnering with both technical users and executive decision-makers to deliver business value.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, understanding customer challenges and positioning Gurobi's optimization technology to meet their objectives.
  • Collaborate with Technical Account Managers, Marketing, and Product teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience throughout the sales process.
  • Represent Gurobi at customer meetings, conferences, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management, forecasting, and customer activity within Salesforce to support effective pipeline management and business planning.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive activity, and developments within optimization, analytics, and enterprise software.

    • What experience and qualifications should you have?
  • 5–7 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales or SMB/enterprise account management with a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience selling complex or technical software solutions into SMB/enterprise organizations.
  • Experience engaging technical, analytics, engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, or optimization-related buying centers.
  • Demonstrated success managing long, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Technical or engineering background is an advantage.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

    • What skills and abilities should you have?
  • Proficiency in delivering presentations and training sessions effectively.
  • Expertise in negotiation to secure favorable outcomes for Gurobi and its clients.
  • Strong conflict resolution skills to protect the customer experience and enhance Gurobi's image.
  • Ability to create compelling value propositions for partners.
  • Proficiency in strategic and analytical thinking to assess decisions' internal and external impact.
  • Aptitude for using data to plan and execute strategies effectively.
  • Satisfaction and ability to operate effectively from a home office in a remote work environment.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Nordics/Benelix for customer meetings, partner engagements, industry events, and conferences, with occasional international travel for company meetings and training.
  • Ability to participate in meetings across different time zones within reasonable expectations.
  • Motivated ambition to achieve assigned Objective Key Results (OKRs).

    • What other requirements should you have?
  • Advanced-level technical B2B SaaS sales experience: Demonstrated expertise and success in selling B2B software solutions in a technical environment.
  • Fluency with macOS, Microsoft 365, and Power BI: Proficiency in using these tools to effectively manage and analyze data, collaborate, and deliver presentations.
  • Comfortable with learning and utilizing Salesforce: Ability to quickly learn and leverage Salesforce, a widely used customer relationship management (CRM) platform, to effectively manage sales activities and customer interactions.
  • Comfortable working in an international setting and with a US-based company.
  • Where applicable, a valid passport and the ability to obtain necessary international travel documents.
    •  

    Your Alignment with our Gurobi Core Values:
  • Customer Focus: Verbal & written communication skills that bring clarity and build trust. 
  • Power of the Team: Motivated with a team-oriented mindset that aims to both inspire and be inspired by others.
  • Innovation: The courage to bring ideas forward and see yourself as an integral part of our global team. 
  • Dedication: Organized and agile, focusing on meeting professional objectives while promoting a healthy work/life balance. 
  • Integrity: Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility.

data.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Senior Java Engineer to join our customer-facing Search team in our Demand Division. This team owns the first crucial step in the booking funnel and focuses on providing a fast and intuitive user experience to our customers in 40+ countries worldwide.

As a Search team, our goal is to simplify the user experience and provide enough information — without overwhelming the user — to help customers find their perfect trip easily. We achieve this by analyzing anonymous behavior data and conducting regular user research, ensuring we focus on good solutions for real user issues. Looking ahead, we aim to make even greater use of our big data to enhance the user experience with relevant statistics and insights at the right moment in the journey.

You'd join an autonomous, cross-functional squad — a Product Owner, backend and frontend engineers, plus data & UX partners and principal engineers who've built this engine at scale. Honest retros, short standups, real ownership from concept to production. We also invite you to be an active contributor to the Engineering Community and challenge the status quo at FlixTech!

About the Role

  • Be at the forefront of Flix's booking funnel, handling millions of search requests per day from Web, App, and external partners
  • Generate the inventory to allow customers to reach any place on our network (3,000+ destinations in 40+ countries!)
  • Apply your geekiness: have you ever wondered what to do with graph theory? This is the team for you!
  • Write SOLID, maintainable, flexible, testable, and scalable code
  • Design components and integrations within team scope, considering scalability, maintainability, and reliability
  • Lead adoption of better engineering practices and adapt workflows for team efficiency
  • Prioritise and plan tech debt pay-down with the team; drive strategies to reduce recurring debt
  • Ensure team code is observable and design monitoring strategies for new components
  • Support our CI/CD environment and produce a positive impact with each release
  • Support our agile, flexible, team-oriented development to bring the search product to the next level

About You

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant industry experience
  • 7+ years of commercial experience as a Java Engineer
  • Strong experience with Java/JVM-based frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring Boot
  • Solution-oriented attitude with a focus on materializing the business vision through technical means
  • Experience with k8s and AWS
  • Experience with database management systems such as MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Solid experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka or others)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
  • Experience with Redis and Terraform
  • Familiarity with CI/CD best practices (unit and integration testing, GitLab CI)
  • Experience working with scalable systems handling large volumes of requests/data

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

data.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Requirements

  • Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Statista's core platform capabilities, aligning technical investments with company-wide product and business goals

  • Translate complex platform challenges into clear, prioritized requirements and work closely with engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions across areas such as data infrastructure, APIs, and internal tooling

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to accelerate platform development, improve developer experience, and unlock new capabilities for product teams

  • Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on platform priorities, trade-offs, and delivery timelines

  • Evaluate and shape integration strategies for emerging technologies, including AI/ML services, MCP protocols, and data pipeline architectures

  • Continuously assess platform performance, scalability, and reliability, driving improvements through data-informed decision-making and close collaboration with engineering leadership

Responsabilities

About the role

Taktile is building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

Taktile is a hybrid company. This role requires working at least 3 days per week from our Berlin HQ, London Office or Iasi Hub.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript.

  • Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

  • Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong.

  • Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback.

  • Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense.

  • Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence.

  • Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions.

  • Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

  • For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well.

Team's tech stack

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Data: DynamoDB, Postgres

  • Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway)

  • AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution

Requirements

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in a remote environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI.

  • Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position).

  • Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces.

  • Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

Nice but not required

  • Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization.

  • FastAPI and Pydantic experience.

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

  • Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy. Getting there requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, heating work as one, and work at the edge of what each discipline can deliver on its own. You will own the complex calculations that set the requirements each system needs to be designed against. You will be accountable for providing the engineering design teams with reasonably estimated and correctly validated load cases that drive the design of the machine.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own simulation pipelines end to end. From physics assumptions through to the machine-defining load cases you provide the subsystem to teams. You own the whole chain, not a step in it.

  • Build the simulators. Finite-element models where that's the right instrument, a reduced-order model coded from scratch where it isn't, all of it properly interfaced with our codebase.

  • Set the interfaces. Define with each engineering team what goes in, what comes out, what it means and what it doesn't cover.

  • Scan the space. Run parameter sweeps and simulation campaigns at scale to settle machine-level tradeoffs before they're locked in.

  • Prove the numbers. Benchmark, cross-check against analytical limits and experiment, and know the boundary where your model stops being trustworthy.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You range across physics and geometry. You are not afraid of jumping between Lorentz forces in a stellarator and the 3D geometry.

  • You've earned that breadth. A PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and time spent where multiphysics analysis actually drives hardware decisions: space, accelerators, semiconductors, aircraft, or anywhere else complex machines get built at scale.

  • You build in code like an engineer, not a scripter. Git, CI/CD, and the PyData stack are second nature, and you've shipped real software, not a folder of one-off scripts.

  • You reach for whatever tool fits. Pen and paper, a solver you wrote last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.

  • You think in pipelines. Automation, reproducibility, validation. And you can tell when a passing series of tests isn't actually telling the truth.

  • You're proactive. You find the gap before it becomes a problem, prioritize hard, and argue for the next step.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at PF3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

You’ll own the development of high-impact, long-term relationships with regional partners, helping them build successful service offerings around n8n and supporting our growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Here’s how you’ll make that happen:

🔍 Acquire and qualify high-potential DACH partners

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard consulting firms, boutique systems integrators, and digital agencies across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

  • Build a strong understanding of the regional partner landscape and prioritize firms aligned with our go-to-market strategy.

  • Assess partner-market fit, technical capabilities, customer reach, and commercial potential.

  • Recruit partners motivated to build and scale dedicated automation and AI service offerings around n8n.

  • Develop relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organizations, from founders and practice leads to sales and delivery teams.

🧠 Enable, support, and scale partnerships

  • Design and deliver onboarding, enablement, and certification programs that help partners become commercially and technically successful.

  • Support partners in building internal n8n expertise, service packages, and repeatable implementation capabilities.

  • Create reusable resources, including playbooks, toolkits, templates, and best practices, to scale partner operations.

  • Drive partner education across technical, sales, and go-to-market tracks.

  • Help partners move from initial onboarding to active pipeline generation and customer delivery.

📈 Drive pipeline and co-selling success

  • Build, track, and grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across the DACH region.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to identify and activate opportunities.

  • Develop joint account plans and co-selling motions for strategic customers and prospects.

  • Co-own joint business plans with priority partners and ensure they deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Maintain clear visibility into partner performance, pipeline progression, and revenue contribution.

📣 Activate regional go-to-market initiatives

  • Plan and execute joint campaigns, webinars, events, and regional initiatives with partners.

  • Build strong relationships with local sales and field teams to ensure partners are embedded within regional go-to-market activity.

  • Co-create German-language content and marketing initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and demand.

  • Represent n8n at relevant partner, industry, and technology events across the DACH region.

  • Keep the partner ecosystem engaged through regular communication, updates, and community initiatives.

🌀 Champion partner feedback and continuous improvement

  • Act as the voice of DACH partners internally, sharing insights that shape future programs, incentives, and product priorities.

  • Identify regional challenges and opportunities, and translate them into scalable improvements.

  • Use partner and performance data to improve the partner experience and increase operational efficiency.

  • Contribute to the evolution of n8n’s global partner program based on regional learnings.

  • Help define what excellent SI partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🚀 SaaS partnership experience: You have 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, alliances, or sales within fast-scaling SaaS or technology companies, including at least 3 years working directly with services partners as a quota-carrying individual contributor.

  • 🇩🇪 Fluent German and English: You are fluent in German and English and can confidently manage commercial negotiations, executive relationships, enablement sessions, and partner communications in both languages.

  • 🌍 DACH market knowledge: You have a strong understanding of the German, Austrian, and Swiss technology and consulting ecosystem, with an established network or proven experience developing relationships in the region.

  • 🤝 Partner recruitment and enablement: You have recruited, onboarded, and scaled high-performing consulting, agency, or systems integration partners.

  • 📈 Commercial ownership: You have owned partner-sourced pipeline or revenue targets and know how to move partnerships from relationship-building to measurable commercial results.

  • ⚡ High-growth mindset: You have thrived in fast-paced technology environments and know how to prioritize, execute, and make decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • 📣 Strong communicator and collaborator: You build trust quickly and influence senior internal and external stakeholders with clarity, credibility, and confidence.

  • 💻 Technical depth: You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, automation workflows, and the broader AI and automation landscape.

  • 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You enjoy creating programs and processes from scratch rather than maintaining static playbooks. You are hands-on, data-driven, and focused on outcomes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💼 Larger deal experience: You have supported partner-involved deals in the €100K to €500K range.

  • 🎯 GTM and co-sell experience: You understand regional go-to-market strategy, partner sales enablement, account mapping, and field collaboration.

  • 🔧 Industry knowledge: You have experience with iPaaS, workflow automation, AI, developer tools, or another technical SaaS platform.

  • 🏢 SI and enterprise experience: You have worked with systems integrators supporting complex software implementations for mid-market and enterprise customers.

  • 🌐 Regional network: You already have relationships with influential consulting firms, boutique SIs, digital agencies, or technology partners across the DACH region.

data.description:
Protect what matters. 

Primion Technology ist globaler Lösungsanbieter und Marktführer für Converged Security Solutions und Workforce Management. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren betreuen wir weltweit rund 4.000 zufriedene Kunden, die täglich auf unsere zertifizierten Lösungen vertrauen. Von der Beratung über die Planung, Entwicklung, Installation und Wartung bis hin zum Support arbeitet ein Team aus über 470 engagierten Experten mit Leidenschaft daran, höchste Qualitätsstandards zu erfüllen. 

Du suchst keine Standard-Montagejobs, sondern möchtest komplexe Sicherheitslösungen mit echter Systemintelligenz zum Leben erwecken?
Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig: Als Systemberater (m/w/d) installierst und konfigurierst du unser High-End-Leitstandsystem pSM, das Sicherheit auf ein neues Level bringt – inklusive Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Einbruchmeldetechnik, Zutrittskontrolle und mehr. Du verbindest Technik mit Verantwortung – und sorgst dafür, dass im Ernstfall jede Sekunde zählt.

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bewirb Dich noch heute für einen unserer Standorte in Stuttgart, Karlsruhe oder Stetten am kalten Markt als Software Consultant (m/w/d) – Sicherheitstechnik!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du installierst und konfigurierst die modulare Sicherheits­management-Plattform prime SecurityManagement, die verschiedene Sicherheits­systeme in den Bereichen Videoüberwachung (Milestone, AXIS, i-Pro), Einbruchmelde- und Brandmeldeanlagen (Telenot, Honeywell), Fluchtwegtechnik (Assa Abloy) und das hauseigene Zutrittskontrollsystem prime WebAccess integriert und zentral steuert.

  • Du erstellst die Schnittstellen für den Datenimport und Datenexport und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Go-Live bei unseren Kunden.

  • Du hältst Schulungen und befähigst unsere Kunden zum Umgang mit den für sie relevanten Funktionen.

  • Im Zuge der regelmäßigen Wartung der Software führst Du erforderliche Tests und Updates durch.

  • Sollten Störungen auftreten, analysierst Du das Problem und findest eine Lösung.

  • Du erstellst Lasten- und Pflichtenhefte.

  • Sollten sich Aufgaben nicht per Fernwartung oder Video-Call lösen lassen, besuchst Du die Kunden in der Region Süddeutschland persönlich.



Dein Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, z. B. Informatik, oder Berufsausbildung, z. B. Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration oder Anwendungsentwicklung, Elektroniker (m/w/d) der Fachrichtung Informations- und Telekommunikationstechnik. Eine Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker (m/w/d) o. Ä. ist von Vorteil

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Installation von Sicherheitstechnik (CCTV, EMA oder BMA)

  • Gute Kenntnisse der Betriebssysteme Windows Server und Windows Client

  • Verständnis für den Aufbau, Auslastung und potenzielle Fehler in Netzwerken

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Skriptprogrammierungen sowie Datenbanken (MS SQL)

  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

  • Führerschein der Klasse B bzw. 3 sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Region Süddeutschland


Deine Benefits

Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten?

We take care of you while you take care of your business! Wir hören besser zu und schauen genauer hin. Unser Anspruch ist es, langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen, die von gegenseitigem Respekt und Vertrauen getragen sind.

Deshalb bieten wir Dir:

  • ein Teil unseres agilen, funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Teams zu werden

  • verantwortungsvolle und vielfältige Aufgaben in einem wachsenden mittelständischen Unternehmen

  • flexible und planbare Arbeitszeiten sowie ein modernes, attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit mobilem Arbeiten

  • Sicherheit und Perspektive durch einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Personalentwicklungsangebote mit der Möglichkeit zur beruflichen & persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Angebote zu arbeits- und betriebsmedizinischen Themen

  • zahlreiche und spannende Corporate Benefits, dazu zählen unter anderem Rabatte bei Reisen, Freizeit und Wohnen

  • einen Firmen PKW mit privater Nutzung


Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
